giorgiozamboni-prospeak-root.description: Rewrites EXISTING text into the register of a professional world (board, deck, LinkedIn, postmortem, offerta tecnica, bando, CV), keeping it credible and not AI-sounding: it adds the jargon on purpose. Use whenever the user wants a text to sound more professional, executive, managerial, technical, formal, "da ufficio marketing", to raise or adjust the register, tune the tone for an audience (capo, CFO, cliente, management), calibrate how much English or itanglese to use, or "buzzword it up", even if they never say "corporate". Two dials: five intensity levels and thirteen sector branches…
